integrity: All-length classification is proved by geometry of roots of unity and integral resultants. Twelve-digit residues and Hensel obstructions have an exact standalone checker. Finite computation is not used in place of an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact normalized GCD spectra are computed only at lengths six and twelve; other exceptional lengths have a resultant-based finite bound and period, not a closed spectrum. Priority is assessed against inspected sources only. The proof has not been independently audited.
title: Neighboring-base repunit GCD growth and the exact twelve-digit spectrum
